verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for multi-currency pricing, localized storefronts, translations, or duties. The only nearby items are bare module titles (Tax Module, Sales Channel Module, Storefront Development Guides) with no content about international selling, and tax is not duties. A community comment also reports that product title and description are single strings with no easy way to localize text across regions, which argues against translation support.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell internationally with localized storefronts, multi-currency pricing, translations, and duties handled
